purpose: Discriminate the exact failure class of the ATTEMPT-004 bootstrap simulation gate without mutations.
ordered_steps: Verify repository HEAD, branch and authorization identity.
Verify no inherited AWS credential environment or persisted temporary profile.
Establish identity only under a separately authorized ephemeral session.
Run one control simulation with a known read-only action and exact principal ARN.
Run bootstrap checks sequentially and stop at the first non-allowed or API error.
Capture exit code and sanitized AWS error class before governance mapping.
Clear process credentials and publish redacted evidence.
success_condition: One exact, evidence-backed failure class is identified or the result is explicitly INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without any mutation.
